no_performance_claim: This manifest records a review of structural feasibility and research design only. It contains no P&L, return, expectancy, win rate, drawdown, Sharpe, Sortino, CAGR, equity curve, bootstrap, Monte Carlo, optimisation, backtest, paper-trade or live-trade result. No outcome was observed at any stage of the reviewed programme. Non-overlapping observations are not independent observations. No candidate is shown to be profitable or unprofitable, and feasibility failure is not a profitability finding.

recommendation.conditional_alternative: D2 framework repair (owner-declared minimum effect, verified venue cost, derived dependence-aware sufficiency rule, arms-length audit), followed only then by a single pre-registered A-family variant (D3)
recommendation.not_recommended: Stage 2L on A, B, C or D; lowering the 150 floor; relaxing the 26 bp cost gate
recommendation.only_object_at_the_floor: Candidate A unconditioned control arm, 150 matched-window non-overlapping events, explicitly not promoted
recommendation.primary: STOP the current strategy family under the current research framework
recommendation.reversal_requires: new separately authorized work: verified cost plus computed D canonical count, or a pre-registered A-family variant meeting a derived rule, or an owner declaration of a much larger minimum effect

authorized: read Stage 2A-2J documentation and machine-readable artifacts
write the four Stage 2K review documents
